## You will be able to

- Design lead-qualification and enrichment agents
- Integrate AI with CRM safely
- Measure pipeline impact

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_rank_workflows.py` | 1 | 12 | six sales-ops workflows scored on volume, rule clarity, data access, reversibility and value — and which should stay manual |
| 2 | `02_lead_qualification_agent.py` | 2 | 20 | an agent that enriches, scores and routes a lead using three read tools and one write tool gated by human approval — plus what happens when it tries something out of scope |
| 3 | `03_metrics_and_governance.py` | 3 | 12 | a weekly metrics sheet — conversion, cost per lead, override rate, data-rule breaches — with thresholds that trigger a review |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
